name: g70_skillswap_swap_back
purpose: Skill Swap (step G70, decision 0041): Gardevoir (F) swaps with Liepard (F, Unburden) twice: the first swap gives Liepard the Pressure that Gardevoir copied at its entry, the second gives Liepard back its own Unburden, so the copy is cleared (the holder is at its sheet ability again). The foe only protects and sets up, so Gardevoir stays in for both swaps.
